title: PipelinePhase
description: The canonical phase-contract object (ADR-0006). A pipeline is ordered phases; each phase carries its id, the agent and (optionally) the model tier that run it, the gate set that must pass, its fan-out strategy (single|fleet), and the original goal it serves. Fleet is a phase strategy; a Workflow is a degenerate single-phase pipeline compiled to this same shape. Phase 2 makes this the CONSUMED spine: it validates real authored pipeline YAML, so only id and agent are hard-required; gate/tier/strategy/goal and the authored fields (description/inputs/outputs/rules/checks/loop/no_gate_reason/no_outputs_reason) are optional — the harness loader (harness_core/pipelines.py::pipeline_phases) materializes their canonical defaults (strategy=single, goal carried from the pipeline, empty gate) at load time and model_tiers.py resolves the model. A gateless phase documents itself with no_gate_reason. additionalProperties stays false so a typo in a known field is still rejected.

id.description: Stable phase identifier, unique within a pipeline.

agent.description: The agent/role that executes this phase.

tier.description: Optional model tier for this phase (resolved by harness_core/model_tiers.py, e.g. 'planning', 'implementation', 'review'). When omitted the harness resolves a default tier.

model.description: Optional explicit model id, overriding the tier when a concrete model is pinned.

gate.description: The gate set that must pass before this phase is allowed to proceed/hand off.

required.description: Names of gates (from the harness gate registry) that must be green. May be empty.

strategy.description: Fan-out strategy: a single agent, or a Fleet of worktree-isolated workers. Optional in authored YAML; defaults to 'single' at load time.

goal.description: The original goal this phase serves (carried through for goal-alignment checks). Optional in authored YAML; the loader carries the pipeline description/goal into each phase when omitted.

description.description: Human-authored description of what this phase does.

inputs.description: Authored list of input artifacts/paths this phase reads.

outputs.description: Authored list of output artifacts/paths this phase produces.

rules.description: Authored ordered heuristics/policies the agent applies during this phase.

checks.description: Authored list of things this phase inspects/looks for (e.g. retrospective signals).

loop.description: Marks this phase as delegating to a sub-pipeline (a nested loop).

pipeline.description: Path to the sub-pipeline YAML this phase loops over.

no_outputs_reason.description: Documented reason a phase legitimately produces no outputs.

no_gate_reason.description: Documented reason a phase legitimately has no required gates.
